title: 第25章 哈库拉玛塔塔第26章 得加钱
content_zh:
;;
理论上来讲，单纯的灵力并没有疗伤的作用。
有疗伤作用的是特殊的法术。
木属性的灵力或许在疗伤方面有些作用，不过云阳的灵根是火土金三属性的，和木属性并不沾边。
修炼的《归元合一诀》是炼体功法，也不讲究灵根的属性。
但云阳却见到，被自己灵力灌注的小猫，身上的伤口竟在逐渐的愈合！
这不合理！
虽然自己只是个修仙小白，但毕竟是快要筑基的人了，这点基础到最基础的修仙知识云阳还是能从修炼的功法里得知的。
也就是说，自己手里的这只小猫，其实有特殊能力的！
嘶~这不会是只妖吧？
“喵~”
云阳正怀疑着，被云阳灌注灵力的小猫已经缓缓醒来，慵懒的打了个哈欠。
云阳检查了一下地上的这只小猫，发现身上的伤口已经全部愈合了。
这种自愈能力，有点厉害了哈。
要知道这小猫可是刚被开膛破肚了，甚至那只巨鼠已经把头探进这只猫的肚子里啃食内脏了，可这才不到半分钟，这只小猫已经恢复如初，甚至连猫毛都完全长出来了。
炼气期修士使用治愈法术都不一定有这小猫恢复的快啊。
见这小猫已经恢复过来了，云阳随即停止了灵力供应。
可没想到这一停止灵力供应，这小猫竟先不愿意了。
“喵喵！”
小猫跳起来，竖着尾巴，模样着急的围着云阳的手打转。

时不时的舔云阳的手指一下，仿佛在说，刚刚的东西呢？
“喵喵喵？”
刚刚的东西呢？
“嘿你这小猫，吃灵力吃上瘾了还？”
“喵！”
“那你跟我走，我让你吃灵力如何？”
“喵？”
小猫非常人性化的疑惑了一下，随后竟点了点头。
这智商，果然成精了吧！
“那就走吧。”云阳将这小猫抱起，抓着小猫的后背，并在指尖输送一缕灵气给这小猫。
“看你通体玄黑，那就叫你小黑吧。”
“喵？喵~”
小黑先是疑惑的叫了声，但随即就沉沦在云阳的抚摸与输送的灵气中了。
随便吧喵~有好吃的就行吧喵~
这猫也是心大，竟全然忘却自己刚刚被开膛破肚，濒临死亡的事情。
“走吧，先带你去洗个澡去。”
“喵~”
归元合一诀除了是体修功法外，主打的也是一个修炼者灵气储量大，续航能力强，就这灵气输送速度，要是一个正常的炼气期修士，还真喂不饱这小黑猫。
走回宿舍，这会儿张古去了健身房，赵江在打游戏，薛子杰在床上刷着视频。
就是没有学习的。

真是堕落。
“哦，阳哥回来了。”
content_en:
;;
Theoretically speaking, pure spiritual power has no healing effect.
There are special spells that have a healing effect.
The spiritual power of the wood attribute may have some effect in healing, but Yunyang's spiritual root is of the three attributes of fire, earth, and gold, and has nothing to do with the wood attribute.
The "Gui Yuan He Yi Jue" practiced is a physical training method, and it does not pay attention to the attributes of the spiritual root.
But Yunyang saw that the wounds on the kitten that had been infused with his spiritual power were gradually healing!
This is unreasonable!
Although he is just a novice in cultivating immortals, he is about to establish a foundation after all. Yunyang can still learn this basic to the most basic knowledge of cultivating immortals from the cultivation techniques.
In other words, the kitten in my hand actually has special abilities!
Hiss~ Isn't this a monster?
"Meow~"
Just as Yunyang was doubting, the kitten that had been infused with spiritual power by Yunyang slowly woke up and yawned lazily.
Yunyang checked the kitten on the ground and found that all the wounds on its body had healed.
This self-healing ability is quite amazing.
You must know that this kitten has just been disemboweled, and even the giant rat has poked its head into the cat's belly to eat the internal organs. However, in less than half a minute, the kitten has recovered as before, and even its fur has completely grown out.
The healing spells used by the monks in the Qi refining stage may not be as fast as this kitten's recovery.
Seeing that the kitten had recovered, Yunyang immediately stopped the supply of spiritual power.
Unexpectedly, when the supply of spiritual power was stopped, the kitten was unwilling to do so.
"Meow meow!"
The kitten jumped up, raised its tail, and circled around Yunyang's hand anxiously.
From time to time he licks Yunyang's finger, as if to say, where was that thing just now?
"Meow meow meow?"
What about what just happened?
"Hey, you little kitten, are you addicted to spiritual power?"
"Meow!"
"Then how about you come with me and I let you eat spiritual power?"
"Meow?"
The kitten was very humane and confused for a moment, and then nodded.
This IQ is really perfect!
"Then let's go." Yunyang picked up the kitten, grabbed the kitten's back, and sent a ray of spiritual energy to the kitten on his fingertips.
"Looking at your black body, let's call you Xiaohei."
"Meow? Meow~"
Xiao Hei screamed in confusion at first, but then he fell into Yunyang's caress and the spiritual energy conveyed.
Whatever, meow~ As long as there is something delicious, okay~
This cat was also very arrogant and completely forgot about the fact that he had just been disemboweled and was on the verge of death.
"Let's go, I'll take you to take a bath first."
"Meow~"
In addition to being a physical cultivation method, Guiyuanheyi Jue also focuses on cultivators with large spiritual energy reserves and strong battery life. With this spiritual energy transmission speed, a normal monk in the Qi refining period would really not be able to feed this little black cat.
Walking back to the dormitory, Zhang Gu went to the gym, Zhao Jiang was playing games, and Xue Zijie was watching videos on the bed.
There is just no learning.
What a depravity.
"Oh, Brother Yang is back."
